description: Renovate configuration for homelab Helm charts with automated chart version bumping

dependencyDashboard.title: Renovate Dashboard: Helm Charts
dependencyDashboard.header:
Tracks dependency updates for the homelab Helm charts.

**After merging**: CI publishes updated charts to the [OCI registry](https://registry.example.com/example-org/helm-charts); [argo-apps](https://source.example.com/example-org/argo-apps) picks them up on its next Renovate run.

---

packageRules.description: Docker digest pinning - Pin floating tags to reproducible digests
Allow unstable versions for SearXNG (rolling release tags)

PostgreSQL server image - cap at major 18. A Postgres major is a data-format migration (dump/restore runbook in argo-apps), never an unattended bump; raise together with argo-apps' postgres-db-create-jobs '<19' cap. The backup CronJob shares image.* with the server on purpose, so no sub-image exclusion is needed for this chart.

Valkey server image - cap at major 9. Shared-instance data (job queues, app state) makes a major a planned migration, never an unattended bump; the backup CronJob shares image.* with the server on purpose, so no sub-image exclusion is needed for this chart.
CouchDB (obsidian chart) - cap at major 3. A CouchDB major changes the on-disk format and config layout, so it is a planned migration, never an unattended bump.

PRIMARY chart image VERSION updates (tag bumps) - bumps the chart version by the image's update type (patch, minor or major), so argo-apps sees the real update type on the chart pin and applies its lane; rewrites appVersion. The sed is unconditional within its branch, so this rule must exclude every init/sidecar sub-image (see the sub-image rule below) — otherwise whichever image bumped last writes ITS tag into appVersion (busybox once overwrote pgadmin's).

Init/sidecar SUB-IMAGE tag bumps - same per-chart grouping and update-type chart bump as the primary rule, but NO appVersion rewrite (appVersion tracks the primary application image only). Add any new init/sidecar image name here AND to the exclusion in the primary rule above.
